name: EpicMail
description:
A unified inbox for Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, iCloud, IMAP, and POP3.

EpicMail is available as a native Android app built with .NET MAUI and as a companion browser app. It helps people with multiple email accounts read, search and reply from one inbox. Web setup and a valid card are required before adding email accounts. The Adventurer plan remains $0 unless the user upgrades.

All your inboxes. Finally together.
author: Serge Sagan
